lcc_original: 就在這一天、挪亞就進了樓船；挪亞的兒子，閃、含、雅弗、和挪亞的妻子、跟他的三個兒媳婦也和他一同進去。
notes: LCC restructures into two clauses with a repeated verb: WH0935/WTH8804 tagged on first 進了 (Noah's entry); the second 進去 is LCC's structural addition for the remaining subjects (sons, wife, DIL) and is left unannotated since the Hebrew בָּא occurs only once.
{WH05146} (pronominal suffix -ו 'his' on בָּנָיו 'his sons') dropped from braces and attached to the explicit LCC 挪亞 in ；挪亞的兒子 per Rule 3 — LCC writes Noah's name where UNV uses an implicit pronoun.

WAH0854 (אִתָּם 'with them', H0854 + 3mp suffix) placed on 和他 in 也和他一同進去, where LCC explicitly expresses accompaniment; in UNV the annotator fronted it to the head of the accompanying-persons list (和他三個兒子), creating an apparent position mismatch.
